description_full:
Category: Education

Location:
Jakarta, DKI Jakarta, ID

**Your impact begins here**
===========================

As an FP&A Data Analyst Intern, you will help turn data into clear, reliable insights for the teams supporting Novo Nordisk’s portfolio. You will maintain and improve existing dashboards, automate recurring reporting processes, and help ensure that the information used for decision-making is accurate and accessible. Your work will enable colleagues to spend less time preparing data and more time understanding performance and taking action.

**What you will do**
====================

You will support the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team across forecasting, monthly closing, and performance reporting. Your responsibilities will include:

* Maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance existing Power BI dashboards to keep them accurate, relevant, reliable, and easy to use.
* Develop new dashboards and reporting solutions in response to evolving business needs.
* Automate recurring reporting and workflow processes using Power Query, Power Automate, Power Apps, and other Microsoft tools.
* Use SQL, Excel, and data-modelling techniques to extract, transform, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources.
* Perform data-quality checks, identify inconsistencies, and work with data owners to resolve issues at the source.
* Translate business questions and user requirements into practical, user-friendly analytics and automation solutions.
* Document dashboards, data flows, business rules, and automated processes to support continuity and knowledge sharing.
* Share findings, progress, and improvement opportunities clearly with FP&A colleagues and relevant stakeholders.

**What you will bring**
=======================

* Current enrolment in an undergraduate or graduate programme in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to working with data.
* Hands-on proficiency in Power BI, Power Query, Microsoft Excel, and SQL.
* Familiarity with Power Automate, Power Apps, data modelling, and reporting automation is preferred.
* Ability to understand a business requirement and translate it into a clear, practical analytics solution.
* Good communication skills and the confidence to ask questions, clarify requirements, and raise potential data issues early.
* A proactive mindset, curiosity, willingness to learn, and the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks.

**Mandatory experience**
========================

Hands-on experience gained through coursework, personal projects, student organisations, competitions, or previous internships in at least one of the following areas:

* Building or enhancing dashboards and data visualisations.
* Cleaning, transforming, combining, or validating data using Power Query, SQL, or comparable tools.
Automating a reporting process, workflow, or repetitive task.

**Who you will work with**
==========================

You will join the FP&A team, which plans, forecasts, and reports financial performance while partnering with commercial and other business functions to turn numbers into actionable insight. You will work closely with colleagues who use dashboards and reports for planning, monthly closing, and performance reviews, as well as with stakeholders responsible for the underlying data. The role reports to the FP&A Manager in Indonesia.

**What you can expect**
=======================

You will work on real reporting and analytics solutions used by the business. You will have room to take ownership, contribute ideas, build practical skills in data analytics and automation, and learn how FP&A supports business decisions. Clear expectations, regular guidance, and constructive feedback will support your development throughout the internship.

**Internship details**
======================

* Duration: 6 months.
* Working arrangement: On-site in Indonesia.
* Benefits: Competitive internship benefits package.

**Apply now**
=============

If you are ready to turn data into practical solutions and help improve the way FP&A works, apply for the FP&A Data Analyst Intern role by 25 November 2026. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.
